sections.text: Tools and Equipment
Work to be Carried Out

Check the bridge 
movement by traveling forward and backward for position low and high.

Check the main 
trolley movement by traversing left and right for position low and 
high.

Check the hoist 
up and down for position low and high.

Check the hoist 
up and down for 2 speeds.

Check limit switches of main trolley for position slow down and stop by 
traversing left and right.

Check the limit switches for position stop for main trolley by hoisting 
up.

Check the limit switches for position slow down for main trolley by 
hoisting up slow down.

Check the limit switches for position stop for main trolley by hoisting 
down, up, down, and anti overlap.

Check the control of the crane with pedant that all 
operations is correct.

Check the control of signaling and lighting that 
all operations is correct.

Check the control of load test at 1.25 of total 
load.
